content:
The safety audit brief generation failed because the required risk rating string was missing from the generated HWPX XML sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the failure indicates that the '위험등급' (Risk Level) mapping from the overview JSON was not correctly injected into the HWPX document structure during the automation process.
